errors.text: The predicted fracture-strain trend is reversed: the target reports that Cr addition and the reticulated Laves phase increase fracture strain from about 11.6% to 14.0%, whereas the hypothesis says the brittle network reduces ductility and identifies the Cr-free baseline as having higher fracture strain.

The proposed processing and testing conditions introduce homogenization or annealing and tensile testing, while the target concerns an as-cast vacuum-arc-melted alloy evaluated by room-temperature compression.

The experiment does not include the matched controls needed to isolate micro-segregation from Cr-specific Laves-phase formation, such as identically processed Cr-free and Cr-containing specimens with quantitative dendritic/interdendritic composition mapping.
